issues.quote: Because Agness infuriated Anna to no end. Especially when

Theodore's reports and elective evaluation sheets—assigned by Agness specifically to torment Theodore, much to Anna's dismay—were swept into the trash bin by the curatress with a single flick of her gold nails.
Because right now, in Agness's office, she and Theodore were discussing Anna's future.
making the Plans a better place
And propping up Seraph's economy even less so.
She held the cigarette with telekinesis
no curiosities, nor any other professorial paraphernalia
Agness claimed this was her way of unwinding
In truth, she was giving it her absolute all.
